name: Romeno (Italy)
description: Horizontal tricolour of green, white and green, the white charged with the municipal arms of Romeno (a rake on green above a yellow field) and the inscription COMUNE DI ROMENO.
history: Municipal flag of Romeno, a comune in Trentino-South Tyrol; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office.

features.role: Romeno arms — rake on green above yellow, with the inscription COMUNE DI ROMENO
